question: Which of the following sponsored 'Ubharte Sitaare Fund', in August 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Exim Bank and SIDBI.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Exim Bank and SIDBI sponsored the **'Ubharte Sitaare Fund'** in **August 2021.**
 
• The 'Ubharte Sitaare Fund' is a scheme launched by** SIDBI** to support** micro, small, and medium enterprises** (MSMEs) in the country.
 
• Exim Bank and SIDBI have jointly set up a **Rs. 400 crore fund** to support MSMEs in sectors such as **pharmaceuticals, healthcare, food processing, and chemicals.**
 
• The fund aims to provide financial assistance to MSMEs for **expansion, capacity building, and modernization**, as well as to support their working capital needs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **IDBI and LIC **are two separate entities, with IDBI being a** public sector bank** and LIC being a** life insurance company.**
 
• ICICI Bank and HDFC are **both private sector banks** in India.
